key_finding: crm.lead single-model discriminates lead vs opportunity via 'type' field; PLS uses internal Naive Bayes on team-scoped frequency table (no IAP gate); won=probability 100+is_won stage; lost=archived+probability 0; round-robin assignment via cron or manual; date_closed set by write override not direct set

U196-C04.summary: won_status derived from active+probability+stage.is_won; not a direct state machine

U196-C07.summary: Set by write() override when probability>=100 or active=False; cleared when probability>0

U196-C08.summary: Internal NBC on crm.lead.scoring.frequency table; no external IAP call; zero-frequency smoothed by +0.1

U196-C10.summary: Must rebuild frequency table post-migration from historical won/lost data for PLS to work

U196-C18.summary: System parameter crm.lead.auto.assignment toggles rule-based vs manual assignment

U196-C22.summary: Team company_id scopes members and cascades to lead company_id; must map correctly

U196-C24.summary: DB constraint: probability must be 100 in is_won stage; data migration must comply

pls_config_parameters.crm.pls_fields: Comma-separated list of crm.lead field names used in probability calculation
pls_config_parameters.crm.pls_start_date: Earliest date for training data (ISO date string)

won_lost_mechanics.action_set_won: Finds nearest won stage by sequence proximity, writes stage_id + probability=100, unarchives
won_lost_mechanics.action_set_lost: Archives lead (active=False) + probability=0; accepts lost_reason_id via kwargs
won_lost_mechanics.action_restore: Unarchives + resets probability to automated_probability value
won_lost_mechanics.date_closed_rule: Set when probability>=100 OR active=False; cleared when probability>0 AND active=True

assignment_round_robin.cron_assign: _assign_and_convert_leads(): sorts by (quota, random) desc; preferred domain leads first; then fill

email_alias.team_id_default: Automatically set to the team owning the alias
email_alias.message_new_note: Suppresses gateway user as responsible; maps subject->name, from->email_from
